name: arch-diagram
description: Interactive system diagram generator — self-contained HTML files with no build step. Flowchart/architecture diagrams use Cytoscape.js (fully editable: drag nodes, add/remove nodes and edges, rename labels, bend connection lines, save/autosave). Sequence diagrams are custom SVG with gradient actors, phase bands, numbered steps, and a legend. ER/state/class diagrams use Mermaid. All diagrams include zoom/pan, dark/light theme, click-to-explore node details, and SVG/PNG/PDF export.
